ship_services.title: Complete Marine Engineering and Ship Services for smooth sailing
ship_services.description: With the help of well established group of technicians and professional workers at every Major port across the globe, Global Marine Supplies provides various marine services.

media.vessel_designation: VLCC / Technical Service General Arrangement · Scale 1:500

items.name: Procurement of Ship Spares
items.description: Global OEM and class-certified spare part sourcing for deck machinery, valves and pumps.

items.name: Tank Cleaning Services
items.description: High-pressure butterworth washing, gas-freeing, mucking and cargo hold preparation.

items.name: Delivery of Spares (Onboard)
items.description: Customs clearance, warehousing and launch-boat or crane transfer directly onto the deck.

items.name: Agency Services (at selected ports)
items.description: Full port clearance, husbandry, crew change logistics and port authority coordination.

items.name: Cash to Master
items.description: Secure, insured onboard USD cash delivery directly to the Master with full port compliance.

items.name: Waste and Garbage Disposal
items.description: Certified MARPOL Annex I–V sludge, bilge water and segregated garbage barge reception.

items.name: Maintenance & Repair
items.description: Riding squads and certified port technicians for structural welding, pipework and valve overhauls.

items.name: Motor Rewinding
items.description: Rapid shore-workshop and voyage rewinding, dynamic balancing and varnish curing for marine motors.

items.name: Underwater Services
items.description: Class-approved hull cleaning, propeller polishing, CCTV inspection and sea-chest grating work.
